prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: motion-first conceptual D2K desktop web interface, full screen 1536x1024.
Primary request: "Слайдоскоп" — a raked rack of tinted glass task slides on a luminous goldenrod base. Create a striking designer interface whose physical visual logic makes elegant state-change animation obvious. NOT a generic dashboard, NOT a product photograph, NOT an airline timetable. Actual full-screen control UI for automatic bypass with real domains.
Input references: first is required visual language board, second quality reference. Adopt goldenrod lit bed, charcoal/slate tinted slides, crisp reversed ivory selected plate, 11-degree raked edges, tightly designed condensed black type. Do not copy airline names, fares, photos, timetable rows, giant marketing headline, or off-topic content.
Composition: golden ochre #E6B527 base across viewport, flat luminous material without glossy gradients. Shallow charcoal top bar contains new simple D2K monogram built from three diagonal slide edges, "D2K / СЛАЙДОСКОП", status "Движок работает", nav "Подборы / Семейства / Журнал", and visible small "Демонстрационные данные". No sidebar.
Main composition: broad diagonal SLIDE RACK occupying most canvas, edges raked11degrees while ALL text remains perfectly horizontal and easy to read. Three large tinted slate glass blades slightly offset in depth, never a card grid. Left blade partly recessed labelled "rutracker.org", "TLS 1.2 · IPv4", "Изучаем соединение". Foremost selected blade in opaque warm ivory, large horizontal title "meduza.io", small heading "ВЫБРАННЫЙ ПОДБОР"; across its ruled lower region four stage tabs "Замер / Создание / Проверка / Сохранено", "Проверка" selected charcoal reverse. Clear secondary copy "Проверяем обход", "Проверено вариантов: 2", underlined "Подробности →". Narrow single band of golden light caught along one raked edge represents the moment a state transition arrives, not continuous glow. Right recessed blade is bottle-green tint with "googlevideo.com", "QUIC · IPv4", "Подтверждено", positioned partway into a visibly separate SAVED RACK at lower-right.
Saved rack is three compact aligned overlapping dark slats in lower portion, not table/cards: heading "СОХРАНЁННЫЕ СЕМЕЙСТВА"; labels "googlevideo.com / QUIC · IPv4", "cdninstagram.com / TLS 1.3 · IPv4", "youtube.com / TLS 1.2 · IPv6". Slight edge offset suggests physical insertion and stable slots, labels fully visible. A quiet caption "Новые адреса используют найденное решение". Left margin short large condensed title "ЗАМЕР. / ПЛАН. / РЕЗУЛЬТАТ." but no huge hero occupying task area.
Permanent bottom control strip never moves: "D2K / Работает" with large legible square dark-outline buttons "Остановить" and "Перезапустить"; separately "Telegram / Подключён" and "Выключить". Footnote "Telegram работает независимо. Доступность сайтов не проверяется." No mascot or previous radar mark.
Motion plan embodied in this still: on genuine state transition, one narrow light band travels along raked slide edge for420ms then rests; selected sheet moves forward via bounded transform220ms while all text remains horizontal; after confirmed save its sheet glides450ms into reserved saved-rack slot without shifting controls or the user's selected task; no looping autonomous shimmer/particles. Reduced-motion uses brief opacity change only. Do not print these timings or motion implementation notes in screenshot. The screenshot captures only one tasteful transitional highlight and one confirmed sheet settling into rack, not motion blur.
Typography: bold condensed headings, clean regular horizontal Cyrillic metadata, charcoal and warm ivory contrast, precise 1px inset rulings. Subtle tinted transparency only on recessed slats, no glassmorphism blobs. Functional states and controls prominent. A beautiful coherent field of layered raked geometry.
Constraints: no invented load/uptime/bandwidth/latency, no chart, no fake network topology, no cards grid/sidebar, no marketing CTA, no oldrobot, no perspective camera or browser frame. All domain/protocol/stage labels readable. This is one real application screen with visually legible motion potential, not a moodboard.

motion_plan.confirmed: 450ms slide into reserved saved slot; controls and selection do not shift.
motion_plan.reduced_motion: Brief opacity change only; no loops.
